instruction: OK, now you are facing a door, an entrance door that is closed. You will need to turn to your left and you will need to walk to the, towards the right side of the grand piano that you have in front of you. Then, turn slightly to your right, you will see there's a small hallway, next to that column, to that pillar. You will need to step in the middle of this hallway and then ypu will need to turn around to exit the hall. Now, you are going to walk towards the carpet that is to you left in the dining room area, and you are going to step in the corner of the carpet. Then, turn to your left, you will see an arch doorway. You will need to walk through that entrance to enter the room that is at the end, which is a kitchen. Now, you will need to walk towards the sink that is in the isle in the middle of the kitchen. Now having that sink to your left, walk towards the fridge and then walk a few steps more until the end of the kitchen next to the micorwave. Now, if you turn to your right, in front of you, you have another room with the door open and you see that you have a hallway in fornt of you
